title: Enable SharePoint Framework web part configuration with property panes
shortDescription: SharePoint Framework (SPFx) client-side web parts that users configure with the web part property pane: built-in fields, a custom field control, and the PnP reusable property pane controls.
longDescription: SharePoint Framework (SPFx) client-side web parts that users configure with the web part property pane: built-in fields, a custom field control, and the PnP reusable property pane controls.
This tutorial contains the completed code for the exercises in the Microsoft Learn module Enable SharePoint Framework web part configuration with property panes.
